stories.title: Coleg Cambria signs partnership with US college on AI and digital skills
stories.summary: Coelg Cambria has signed a partnership with Edmonds College in Washington State to swap expertise in AI, digital innovation and workforce development, with student and staff trips to Seattle already planned. stories.title: Delsol asks council to rule overnight lorry movements at Sandycroft depot are lawful
stories.summary: A Sandycroft delivery firm has asked Flintshire County Council to rule that night-time lorry movements at its depot are lawful, despite a planning condition banning operations between midnight and 6.30am. stories.title: Welsh Water bosses’ bonuses blocked after company triggers Ofwat ban
stories.summary: Welsh Water has been banned from paying bonuses to its top bosses for last year after falling foul of the water regulator’s rules. stories.title: Cheshire Police among seven forces inspected over facial recognition searches
stories.summary: Police forces are searching custody photographs that should have been deleted when they use facial recognition to identify suspects, a national inspection has found.
